title: Memorial Acclamation B
text:
When we eat this Bread and drink this Cup,
we proclaim your Death, O Lord,
until you come again.

translation.latin:
Quotiescumque manducamus panem hunc
et calicem bibimus,
mortem tuam annuntiamus, Domine,
donec venias.

notes: This second Memorial Acclamation directly references the Eucharistic elements (Bread and Cup) and connects our participation in the Eucharist with the proclamation of Christ's death and anticipated return. It's based on 1 Corinthians 11:26.
description: When we eat this Bread and drink this Cup
